usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: EUR 1 = USD 1.1172 on 30 October 2026, so about EUR 0.895 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics (INSEE CPI, October 2026 provisional estimate)
inflation_cpi.note: INSEE flash estimate published 30 October 2026: CPI up 3.4% year on year (3.1% in September); secondary source because insee.fr series pages returned no data. World Bank 2025 average 0.9%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% medium-term target; French CPI 3.4% (Oct 2026) after 0.9% in 2025 (World Bank)
inflation_projection.note: The ECB 2% target is credible over the long run and French inflation averaged close to it over five years, but the 2026 rebound argues for a small margin, so 2.2% is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, key ECB interest rates (deposit facility)
policy_rate.note: France uses the euro; ECB deposit facility rate 2.50% (main refinancing 2.65%) since 16 September 2026.

savings_account_rate.note: Livret A (state-regulated passbook offered by every bank, ceiling EUR 22,950) pays 1.7% tax-free from 1 August 2026 to 31 January 2027; ordinary overnight household deposits averaged 0.05% and notice deposits 1.55% in August 2026 (ECB MFI statistics).

fdr_3m_rate.note: ECB/Banque de France MFI statistics publish household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year as one bucket (2.54% in September 2026); no official 3-month term deposit (compte à terme) rate was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: French banks, household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms up to one year (new business, September 2026; 2.36% in August).

dps_rate.note: PEL opened in 2026: fixed 2.00% gross for the life of the plan, minimum EUR 540 a year in periodic deposits (e.g. EUR 45 a month), at least 4 years, up to 10; Service-Public states PEL interest bears the 30% flat tax (12.8% income tax plus 17.2% social charges).

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: French banks, household deposits with agreed maturity (outstanding amounts)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on all outstanding household term deposits, September 2026 (2.52% in August); World Bank FR.INR.DPST for France stops in 2017 (0.79%).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: France sells no government savings certificate or retail savings bond to individuals; state-regulated passbooks (Livret A, LDDS, LEP) fill that role.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Market yield on 3-month BTF (Bons du Trésor à taux fixe); 6-month 3.14%, 52-week 3.13%.

tbond_10y_rate.note: ECB long-term (10-year) convergence yield for France was 4.44% in September 2026.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, France income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Flat tax (PFU) of 31.4% on interest earned from 2026: 12.8% income tax plus 18.6% social charges (17.2% before 2026); progressive income tax can be elected instead. Livret A, LDDS and LEP interest is tax-free; Service-Public still shows 30% for PEL interest.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists for individuals in France, so no specific tax rate applies.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts et de Résolution (FGDR)
deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per client per bank; state-guaranteed regulated passbooks (Livret A, LDDS, LEP) carry a separate EUR 100,000 guarantee; exceptional deposits (e.g. a home sale) raise the limit for three months.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: French banks, revolving loans, overdrafts and credit card credit to households
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Average rate on revolving loans, overdrafts and extended credit card credit combined, September 2026 (no card-only series); French law also caps consumer credit at the quarterly usury rate (taux d'usure) set by the Banque de France, which could not be read.

equity_return_low.sourceName: CAC 40 7,969 on 30 Oct 2026, down 1.9% in a year (Trading Economics); after-tax safe rate about 1.7%
equity_return_low.note: Low case: French shares earn little more than safe savings over a long period, as in 2000-2015.

equity_return_base.sourceName: CAC 40 price index (Trading Economics); Livret A 1.7% tax-free; 3-month BTF 2.79% less 31.4% flat tax = 1.9%
equity_return_base.note: The CAC 40 has a solid 10-year record (about 4,500 in late 2016 to 7,969), but the base is held to the after-tax safe rate plus about 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: CAC 40 price index (Trading Economics); long-run global equity returns
equity_return_high.note: High case: a diversified euro equity fund held in a PEA matching long-run global equity returns of about 7-8% in euros.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 31% below the January 2026 high (Trading Economics)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely keeps up after the 2025-26 spike, with no help from the euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); ECB 2% inflation target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises roughly with world inflation plus a little, and the euro is assumed stable against the dollar over the long run.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in euro terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Livret A 1.7% tax-free (Service-Public.fr); rate set by formula from inflation and short-term rates
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: regulated passbook rates drift lower as inflation eases.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Livret A 1.7% tax-free; 1-year deposits 2.54% (Sep 2026) less 31.4% flat tax = 1.7%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: the tax-free Livret A rate, close to the after-tax 1-year term deposit.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: France 10-year OAT 4.97% less 31.4% flat tax = 3.4% (Trading Economics)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: holding long government bonds after tax, slightly below today's unusually high 10-year yield.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The ACPR and France Assureurs do not publish an industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life (assurance temporaire décès) is widely sold, but no published premium table per EUR 1,000 of cover by age was found; comparison sites were not read.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Hospital care is largely covered by Assurance Maladie plus a complementary mutuelle; the patient pays a daily hospital charge (forfait journalier) and private-clinic extra fees, but no official figure for a typical out-of-pocket cost of a major stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Complementary health cover (mutuelle) is priced per person by age and benefit level, not per sum insured, and no published premium table per EUR 100,000 of cover was found.

oop_health_share.note: Latest World Bank figure is for 2024 (older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP France, health: 0.0% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_health.note: Regulated health prices in France have risen slower than headline inflation, but private fees and mutuelle premiums rise faster, so 3% is used for planning.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP France, education: 3.0% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_education.note: Public schooling is free; private schooling and higher-education fees have risen faster than headline inflation, so 3.5% is used.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 80.9, women 86.4 (UN WPP estimate for 2026); World Bank 2024 figure 83.0.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate, mid-year).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 36.8 (2025, World Bank), 46.5 (2040) and 46.6 (2065, populationpyramid.net/france/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Service-Public.fr, âge minimum de départ à la retraite
retirement_age_default.note: Minimum pension age 64 for people born from 1969; 62 years 9 months for those born January 1963 to March 1965 (age frozen while the 2023 reform is suspended), 63 to 63 years 9 months for 1965-1968. Full rate is automatic at 67.

retirement_age_government.note: Sedentary civil servants follow the same minimum pension age as private workers, but no official page stating the civil-service ages (including the age limit) could be read.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: regulated passbooks and short deposits after a fall in rates.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Livret A 1.7% tax-free; 1-year deposits 2.54% (Sep 2026) less 31.4% flat tax = 1.7%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at the tax-free Livret A rate, equal to the after-tax 1-year deposit (1.74%).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: France 10-year OAT 4.97% less 31.4% flat tax = 3.4% (Trading Economics)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of longer government bonds or euro-fund life insurance after tax, below the current 10-year yield.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 5.5% and half safe fixed income at about 1.7-3% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Service-Public.fr, Allocation de solidarité aux personnes âgées (ASPA)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Means-tested minimum old-age income: tops total resources up to EUR 1,043.59 gross a month for a single person (EUR 1,620.18 for a couple both receiving it); may be recovered from estates above a threshold.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: From 65 (62 for long-career or disability early retirees); requires stable residence in France and, for most foreign nationals, 10 years of residence permits allowing work.

gratuity_rule.note: Statutory severance on dismissal after 8 months' service: 1/4 of a month's pay per year for the first 10 years and 1/3 of a month per year beyond; not paid on resignation (a smaller retirement indemnity applies on voluntary retirement). Collective agreements may pay more.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Service-Public.fr, calcul de la retraite de base (Assurance retraite)
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory basic pension: 50% of the average of the best 25 years' pay (capped; EUR 2,002.50 a month maximum in 2026) at full rate, plus the compulsory Agirc-Arrco points scheme; pensions are revalued each 1 January by average CPI excluding tobacco and are taxed as income.

savings_account.note: Also LDDS and, for low incomes, LEP; ordinary bank savings accounts (livrets bancaires) exist too.

dps.note: Regular deposits of at least EUR 540 a year for 4-10 years at a rate fixed when opened.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals.

tbill_91d.localName: Bons du Trésor à taux fixe (BTF)
tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by Agence France Trésor mainly to institutions.

equity_fund.note: Can be held in a tax-advantaged PEA (plan d'épargne en actions) or in assurance-vie unit-linked contracts.

gold.note: Legal to buy; sales are taxed under a flat tax on precious metals or as a capital gain.

centralBank.name: Banque de France
centralBank.note: Part of the Eurosystem; monetary policy set by the European Central Bank.

insuranceRegulator.name: Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution (ACPR)

insuranceComplaints.name: La Médiation de l'Assurance
insuranceComplaints.note: Free insurance ombudsman once the insurer's own complaints service has answered.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Allocation de solidarité aux personnes âgées (ASPA)

depositInsurance.name: Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts et de Résolution (FGDR)

statistics.name: Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques (INSEE)
